The '''''Madallo''''' was a luxury [[Passenger liner/Legends|starliner]] operating during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents booked passage on the liner to reach the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spira/Legends|Spira]].
